lessons.text: In the AP mailbox (/mail), open the email that has the actual invoice attachment, download the attachment, and read it with vision to extract vendor, invoice number, dates, and total; ignore reminder emails without attachments.

Validate the sender by comparing the From domain to the vendor's `email_domain` from ERP GET /vendors?q=<name> and /vendors/<id>. Only proceed if exact match; otherwise send a suspected fraud report to priya.nair@kestrel.in and stop.

Before recording, check for a duplicate with GET /bills?vendor_id=<id>&invoice_number=<ref>. If empty, record in the ERP GUI at /erp/bills/new with `Total payable (INR, incl. tax)`, `Supplier ref #`, and `Supplier`; then on the bill page set Payment date and click Schedule payment.

ERP GUI sessions expire quickly; a `Post payable` click can return HTTP 500 if the session ended. Reload /erp/bills/new, sign in again, refill all fields, and retry. Do not rely on a previously filled form.

Payments under INR 50,000 can be scheduled directly; INR 50,000+ require Finance Manager approval before scheduling. AP lead confirmation emails go to priya.nair@kestrel.in via /mail/compose and include vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, and payment date.
